name: Circular Mirror with Relief Decoration of Birds, Beasts, and Human Figures
summary: The high beveled rim on this circular mirror sinks downward into four bands of geometric bordering -- sawtooth, chevrons, sawtooth, and short straight radiating lines.  Within the border of radiating lines is a circular ring with an inscription cast in thread relief that encircles the main decorative field.
